general.title: Movement Tutorial
general.intro: First, learn how each movement represents a value.
general.practice: You will practice the largest and smallest movement for each season.

summer.title: Circle radius
summer.explanation: Summer uses the radius of a circle. A larger circle represents a higher value.
summer.maximum: Draw the largest circle with fully extended arms.
summer.minimum: Draw a small circle close to your body.

autumn.title: Horizontal arc extent
autumn.explanation: Autumn uses the length of a horizontal sweep. A longer arc represents a higher value.
autumn.maximum: Sweep through the full horizontal semicircle.
autumn.minimum: Stop after a short horizontal arc.

winter.title: Body height
winter.explanation: Winter uses the height of your body. A smaller body represents a lower value.
winter.maximum: Stay fully upright for the maximum value.
winter.minimum: Crouch low and protect your head.

spring.title: Vertical blooming arc
spring.explanation: Spring uses the length of a vertical blooming arc. A longer upward arc represents a higher value.
spring.maximum: Complete the full arc above your head.
spring.minimum: Make a short, low blooming arc.

winter.openArmsWider: Begin with an open winter shape. Stretch your arms wider.
winter.raiseArmsToShoulders: Lift your arms to shoulder height.
winter.straightenArmsMore: Reach your arms out a little straighter.
winter.crossArmsInFront: Draw the cold inward. Cross your arms in front.
winter.reachOppositeShoulders: Bring each hand toward the opposite shoulder.
winter.keepArmsCrossed: Keep your arms crossed as your body becomes smaller.
winter.stayUpright: It was not quite that cold. Stay a little taller.
winter.stayHigher: It was not quite that cold. Keep your body a little higher.
winter.contractMore: The winter was colder than that. Make your body a little smaller.
winter.bendKneesMore: The winter was colder than that. Bend your knees a little more.
winter.keepBodyCompact: Keep the cold close. Stay small through the movement.

winter.lowerBodyAndProtectHead: The winter was colder than that. Sink lower and protect your head.

spring.reachAboveHead: Let the flower reach above your head.

spring.lowerAndReturn: Lower the flower and return to the starting position.
spring.liftOtherKnee: Let the movement change sides. Lift the other knee.
spring.matchBothHands: Let both sides of the flower rise together.

summer.moveHandsToCenter: Begin at the center. Bring your hands together.
summer.raiseArmsHigher: Lift the summer circle a little higher.
summer.straightenArms: Stretch your arms a little straighter.
summer.stepSmaller: Keep the step a little smaller.
summer.alternateStepSide: Let the movement change sides. Step the other way.
summer.openArmsToSides: The summer was warmer than that. Open the circle wider.
summer.openArmsLess: It was not quite that hot. Keep the circle smaller.
summer.movementTooLarge: It was not quite that hot. Make the movement a little smaller.
summer.movementTooSmall: The summer was warmer than that. Make the movement a little larger.
summer.bendElbowsMore: Soften the circle. Bend your elbows a little more.
summer.returnFeetToCenter: Bring your feet back to the center.
summer.lowerArms: Lower your arms as the circle closes.

autumn.startLeft: Begin the autumn arc on your left.
autumn.startRight: Begin the autumn arc on your right.
autumn.wrongSweepDirection: Let the arc travel toward the other side.
autumn.sweepLeft: Sweep the autumn arc to the left.
autumn.sweepRight: Sweep the autumn arc to the right.
autumn.insufficientProgress: The autumn was warmer than that. Let the arc travel farther.
autumn.endpointTooShort: The autumn was warmer than that. Let the arc travel farther.
autumn.endpointTooFar: It was not quite that warm. End the arc a little earlier.
autumn.endpointReachedTooLate: Let the arc reach its end a little sooner.
autumn.endpointUnstable: Hold the end of the arc for a moment.
autumn.endAtDestinationSide: Carry the arc all the way to the destination side.
autumn.endAtFarDestinationSide: Let the arc travel to the far side.
autumn.endAtCenter: End the arc near the center.
autumn.endBeforeCenter: Stop the arc before it reaches the center.
autumn.endAtStartSideDiagonal: Keep the arc near its starting side and angle it outward.
autumn.alignBothArms: Let both arms follow the same autumn arc.
autumn.extendOuterArm: Stretch the outer arm a little farther.
autumn.keepHandsAtChestHeight: Keep the autumn arc at chest height.
autumn.keepChestForward: Keep your chest facing forward as the arc moves.
autumn.returnHandsToCenter: Bring your hands back to the center.
autumn.returnFeetTogether: Bring your feet together before the next arc.
